scope: affected presentation call sites and localization tests
method: Read-only working-tree diff and source review; lightweight Node.js JSON analysis reproduced the current alias-map and single-pass partial-replacement branch. Reproduced strings below are static algorithm evidence, not Godot UI execution.
acceptance_scope: Findings only. Native UI verification and independent-chat revalidation remain owned by the main thread.

findings.title: Localized ban prefix no longer matches the server wire reason in en/es

evidence.code: new SessionReplacedEventPayload("账号已被封禁：" + reason));

findings.trigger: Select en or es, then receive the server session.replaced ban reason.
findings.result: The raw Chinese reason cannot begin with the localized English/Spanish prefix; the early return suppresses the dedicated ban dialog.
findings.recommendation: Recognize the stable raw protocol marker or a structured ban code independently of UI translation; localize only the displayed dialog title/message prefix and preserve the administrator-authored reason.
findings.verification_needed: Deliver the existing raw server ban payload under zh-CN/en/es; assert that the dialog appears in all three and that an ordinary session replacement does not trigger it.

findings.title: Generic label localization still rewrites player names and administrator-authored mail text
findings.category: retained presentation-boundary bug exposed by rollout

evidence.code: func text(..., localize: bool = true) -> Label:
var display_text := P.localized_text(value) if localize else value
text(title if not title.is_empty() else P.localized("system_mail"), ..., column)

static_reproductions.meaning: The player nickname Fire is rewritten as Fuego.
An untranslated admin mail title is partially rewritten; the mail list retains the raw title but details rewrite it.
An administrator-selected sender name Gold is rewritten.

findings.qualification: Several call sites predate this diff; this is a current, actionable rollout risk rather than a claim that every call was newly introduced. RemoteCopy.field itself correctly returns authored values, but these callers localize them a second time.
findings.recommendation: Use localize=false for text containing player names and RemoteCopy outputs. Localize fixed label templates before interpolation, then preserve all externally authored arguments verbatim.
findings.verification_needed: Render duel names and relic owners named Fire/Gold/装备, and mail title/sender values containing the same aliases, under zh-CN/en/es. Assert exact preservation of authored fragments in visible controls and tooltips, including mail list/detail consistency.

findings.title: Configuration errors cached in the active language do not fully follow later language changes
findings.trigger: Produce a configuration version mismatch while en is selected, then switch to es or zh-CN from settings without making another login request.

static_reproduction.stored_en_message: Server configuration differs. Update the client and log in again (client v1, server v0).
static_reproduction.display_after_switch_to_es: Servidor configuration differs. Update the client and log in again (client v1, server v0).
static_reproduction.display_after_switch_to_zh_CN: 服务器 configuration differs. Update the client and log in again (client v1, server v0).

findings.explanation: The complete formatted message is stored as text. The exact-source alias does not match after interpolation, and formatted aliases are constructed only from Chinese templates. Clearing the formatted-alias cache does not rebuild the stored state. The partial alias pass changes only isolated source terms.
findings.recommendation: Keep a stable message key plus raw format arguments for persistent client-generated status/error state, and render it for the current locale, or explicitly rebuild this state on locale change without rewriting server-authored details.
findings.verification_needed: Create an en/es configuration mismatch, switch through zh-CN/en/es, and inspect configuration_error, authentication_reason and connection presentation. The fixed message should fully follow the selected language while versions and administrator/server details remain unchanged.

coverage_gaps.gap: The non-cascading check uses one equipment count phrase and never sends a raw server ban payload or renders a nickname/admin value that collides with an alias.
RemoteCopy assertions test returned fields; rendered mail coverage at lines 58-65 exercises list rows only, so the detail-view second-localization path escapes detection.
Legacy regression tests are started after resetting to zh-CN. There is no non-Chinese formatted persistent-error state followed by another locale.

Glyph coverage calls body.has_char only. Title/number/scaled font behavior and retained visible control themes on a live locale switch still need native UI evidence; no present es glyph failure was established by this review.

checks_without_findings: The reviewed gateway/http_protocol/platform_service replacements are error/status presentation values; their route names, HTTP media/schema identifiers, command kinds, status codes, auth/session generations and Steam method names remain stable.
game_store configuration-version comparison still compares raw version identifiers before composing its localized error.

set_language resets body and scaled-font readiness flags and clears the formatted-alias cache; current zh-CN/en/es registry entries all use the same body/title font paths, so this read-only review does not assert a demonstrated es font-cache failure.

All three current runtime packs have 824 strings keys. No exact-string alias idempotence mismatch was found across those strings; formatted single-pass checks found no en/es same-locale cascade for numeric placeholder samples.
